race.title: 0% Commission For 110 Days At Matchbook Mares' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: With Sean Bowen back aboard and first-time cheekpieces added, AMBERELLI may be able to capitalise on a lowly mark. October Hill and Yeld To Call also appeal in a very tricky handicap. AMBERELLI OCTOBER HILL (IRE) YELD TO CALL (FR)
